businessObjectives.objective: Shorten time from screening approval to confirmed interview
kpis: At least 3 valid slots suggested when availability exists

businessObjectives.objective: Maintain auditable and secure candidate data handling
kpis: CV data encrypted at rest and in transit

restrictions: cannot finalize pass/fail unless also HR Manager
does not own business hiring decisions

businessRules.name: Human approval is mandatory at business decision gates
businessRules.rule: Screening shortlist, schedule confirmation, and final pass/fail decisions must be approved by HR Manager or designated backup.

businessRules.name: Approval reminders do not imply auto-action
businessRules.rule: Pending approvals may trigger reminders and escalation, but must not auto-approve, auto-reject, auto-cancel, or auto-skip.

businessRules.name: Duplicate candidates require HR review
businessRules.rule: Candidate records with matching email or phone must be flagged for merge/skip/create-new decision.

businessRules.name: MVP file boundary excludes OCR
businessRules.rule: MVP accepts only text-native PDF/DOCX CV/JD files and rejects scanned/image-only files.

businessRules.name: Low-confidence AI or parsing requires manual review
businessRules.rule: AI outputs or extraction results below configured confidence threshold must route to manual review.

businessRules.name: Screening score must remain explainable
businessRules.rule: Screening results must include total score, sub-scores, missing skills, red flags, confidence, and evidence spans.

businessRules.name: Calendar events require approved slot
businessRules.rule: No interview event or confirmation email may be sent until HR Manager approves a suggested slot.

businessRules.name: Scheduling respects timezone and working-hour policy
businessRules.rule: Suggested slots must respect participant timezones, configured working hours, 30-minute buffer, and minimum advance notice.

businessRules.name: MCQ grading is deterministic
businessRules.rule: Multiple-choice answers are graded only against approved answer key, not by LLM judgment.

businessRules.name: Essay and coding AI grading must be rubric-backed
businessRules.rule: Essay and coding AI scores must include criterion-level justification and preserve rubric/test-case versioning for audit.

businessRules.name: Candidate data access is role-bound
businessRules.rule: Confidential candidate documents, transcripts, and submissions are accessible only to roles with business need.

businessRules.name: Audit trail is mandatory for accountability
businessRules.rule: Imports, approvals, overrides, notifications, state changes, and final decisions must be auditable.

businessRules.name: Phase 2 utility AI is in prototype scope but outside MVP acceptance
businessRules.rule: Content generation, mock design generation, CV evidence viewer detail, CV translation, and interview translation are standalone Phase 2 prototype capabilities. They must not block Phase 1/MVP acceptance and must not mutate core candidate pipeline state without explicit approved workflow.

businessRules.name: Workflow communications use approved HR identity and templates
businessRules.rule: Candidate-facing emails and workflow reminders must use the shared HR mailbox, approved templates, and logged delivery status.

businessRules.name: Operational KPIs must be monitored
businessRules.rule: Recruitment operations must monitor screening time, throughput, response time, concurrency, uptime, AI failure, LLM cost, and scalability targets.

businessRules.name: Single-organization operating model
businessRules.rule: RecruitAI serves internal HR only and does not support multi-tenant agency operation in MVP.

businessRules.name: Google Workspace is the business integration standard
businessRules.rule: MVP recruitment communications, scheduling, and Drive ingestion depend on approved Google Workspace accounts and availability.

businessRules.name: Approval stall is accepted business risk
businessRules.rule: Approval queues may remain pending indefinitely; the business accepts reminder/escalation rather than automatic cancellation or skipping.

businessRules.name: Recruitment master data must be business-owned
businessRules.rule: Candidate profile, CV, JD, screening result, interview transcript, test submission, and grade records must have clear HR/System ownership and confidentiality classification.

businessRules.name: AI quality monitoring is ongoing business governance
businessRules.rule: Shortlist precision and prompt/rubric drift must be monitored after launch and reviewed by HR/IT owners.

businessRules.name: Escalation does not create business approval
businessRules.rule: Escalation transfers review responsibility or sends notifications, but it never creates an approve/reject/pass/fail decision without explicit human action. Backup approver identity and timing remain blocking Gate 4 policy decisions.

businessRules.name: Final decision policy placeholder
businessRules.rule: Final pass/fail remains a human-owned HR Manager decision based on screening, interview, and test evidence. The exact combined threshold or weighting model is unresolved and blocks Gate 4.

businessRules.name: Retention policy placeholder
businessRules.rule: Candidate CVs, transcripts, test submissions, and audit records require explicit retention/deletion periods before Gate 4 detail sign-off. Until defined, no destructive deletion behavior may be assumed.

businessRules.name: Calendar reschedule and cancellation policy placeholder
businessRules.rule: Post-approval interview reschedule/cancel behavior is unresolved and must be defined before Gate 4; no Calendar update flow may be assumed beyond initial approved event creation.

businessRules.name: Generated content requires HR approval
businessRules.rule: AI-generated recruitment content must be reviewed and approved by HR before copy, export, file generation, or channel publishing.

businessRules.name: Generated design requires HR approval
businessRules.rule: Mock generated design assets must be reviewed and approved by HR before export, publishing, or operational use.

businessRules.name: AI-generated status must be visible
businessRules.rule: Generated content and mock design assets must be clearly marked as AI-generated or AI-assisted until HR approval is recorded.

businessRules.name: Generated content and design require moderation
businessRules.rule: Recruitment content and mock creative outputs must be reviewed for safety, appropriateness, and policy fit before approval or channel use.

businessRules.name: Original CV is source of truth
businessRules.rule: Translated CVs support review and related workflows, but original CV remains the authoritative record and screening decisions must trace to original CV evidence.

businessRules.name: Original interview record is source of truth
businessRules.rule: Translated interview notes/transcripts support review, but original notes/transcripts remain the authoritative record for audit and final decision evidence.

businessRules.name: CV evidence detail is review support
businessRules.rule: CV evidence viewer detail may support HR review, but it must not create a new automated decision gate or replace existing screening approval authority.

businessRules.name: No OCR without explicit scope decision
businessRules.rule: Scanned/image-only CV support and OCR remain out of scope unless explicitly added; unsupported documents must not be silently inferred.

businessRules.name: Utility AI artifacts follow candidate data privacy rules
businessRules.rule: Translated CVs, translated transcripts, evidence details, generated artifacts, prompts, and approvals must follow role-based access, audit, and retention controls appropriate to their source data.

businessRules.name: Original CV is candidate source of truth
businessRules.rule: Original CV PDF is the authoritative candidate source; CandidateProfile, extraction results, and translations are derived artifacts.

businessRules.name: CV intake is PDF-first without OCR
businessRules.rule: MVP CV intake accepts text-native PDF CV files; scanned/image-only CVs are rejected or flagged because OCR is out of scope.

businessRules.name: CV version changes require HR re-screen decision
businessRules.rule: New CV versions flag HR for manual re-screen decision and must not automatically re-screen later-stage candidates.

businessRules.name: Excel is not primary CV source
businessRules.rule: Excel may supplement CV metadata but must not replace PDF CV as the candidate source.

businessRules.name: Approved parsed JD is matching source of truth
businessRules.rule: HR-approved ParsedJDProfile is the operational source of truth for matching; original JD text/file is retained as evidence/reference.

businessRules.name: JD approval required before screening
businessRules.rule: A ParsedJDProfile must be approved by authorized HR before the JD can be used for screening or matching.

businessRules.name: JD and criteria versioning preserves reproducibility
businessRules.rule: JD updates create JD versions; criteria tuning may create new ParsedCriteriaVersion without changing the original JD document version, and screening remains tied to the versions used.

businessRules.name: External job connectors are mock-only
businessRules.rule: ATS, job board, and career site connectors are prototype-only mock UI/status previews and must not imply real external integration in MVP.

businessRules.name: Screening must trace CV and JD versions
businessRules.rule: Every screening result must store candidateId, cvVersionId, jobId, jdVersionId, and parsedCriteriaVersion.

businessRules.name: Assessment plan follows approved JD criteria version
businessRules.rule: AssessmentPlan must link to jobId, jdVersionId, and parsedCriteriaVersion before interview or test setup is considered usable.

businessRules.name: Shared rubric version is the assessment source of truth
businessRules.rule: AI interview and test grading inherit the approved rubricVersionId and weights unless a visible override is configured and versioned.

businessRules.name: Prototype assessment setup has no real integration side effects
businessRules.rule: Setup changes in this prototype use mock/local state only and must not imply real API persistence, LLM generation, OCR, or external connector behavior.

businessAcceptanceCriteria.criterion: MVP supports full pipeline from import to final decision without requiring Phase 2 utility AI modules.
Every business decision gate has an accountable HR Manager decision recorded.
Every AI recommendation used by HR includes explainability and confidence information.
Candidate confidential data is protected by RBAC, encryption, and audit logs.
Phase 2 utility AI modules are explicitly in prototype scope but do not block Phase 1/MVP pipeline acceptance.
Generated recruitment content and mock design assets require recorded HR approval before export, publishing, or use.
CV and interview translations preserve source linkage, access control, and source-of-truth warnings.
CV evidence detail supports HR review with original/extracted/evidence context and does not introduce OCR or a new automated decision gate.
Assessment setup provides one shared, versioned evaluation source of truth for AI Interview and Test/Assignment prototype flows.

risks.risk: No approval timeout can stall pipeline at scale
risks.mitigation: Reminder, SLA visibility, escalation to backup approver, queue monitoring

risks.risk: AI false rejection may remove qualified candidates
risks.mitigation: Human approval, confidence threshold, validation dataset, false reject review
RBAC, encryption, audit logs, access-controlled CV storage

risks.risk: Coding challenge execution introduces security risk
risks.mitigation: Gate implementation on approved sandbox/runtime decision

risks.risk: Scanned PDFs/images are expected by users despite MVP boundary
risks.mitigation: Clear rejection reason and Phase 2 OCR backlog

risks.risk: Unapproved AI-generated recruitment content may be published externally
risks.mitigation: Require HR approval, visible AI-generated status, moderation review, and audit trail before copy/export/channel publishing

risks.risk: Mock generated design may be mistaken for approved brand asset
risks.mitigation: Mark mock assets as AI-assisted draft until HR approval; keep real provider integration out of scope

risks.risk: Translated CV may be misused as source of truth for screening
risks.mitigation: Show source-of-truth warning and require screening decisions to trace to original CV

risks.risk: Translated CV or interview transcript may expose confidential candidate data
risks.mitigation: Apply RBAC, audit, retention, and source-linked access controls to translated artifacts

risks.risk: Channel integration scope may expand beyond prototype readiness
risks.mitigation: Treat channel integrations as Phase 2 prototype connectors with explicit channel decision question

risks.risk: Drive CV trigger or scan may miss files or surface invalid folder contents
risks.mitigation: Import error report, retry/backoff, HR notification, manual multi-file upload fallback

risks.risk: LLM CV extraction may produce low-confidence CandidateProfile
risks.mitigation: Store extraction confidence/errors, require HR review on low confidence, preserve original CV source of truth

risks.risk: Unapproved or poorly parsed JD could distort screening
risks.mitigation: Require HR approval of ParsedJDProfile before screening and retain original JD evidence

risks.risk: Weak JD/CV version traceability can make screening decisions non-reproducible
risks.mitigation: Store candidateId, cvVersionId, jobId, jdVersionId, and parsedCriteriaVersion on each screening result

risks.risk: Prototype mock external connectors may be mistaken for real integrations
risks.mitigation: Mark connector status as mock/prototype-only and exclude real API expectations from MVP

checks.check: Business rules separated from system behavior
Use cases include business acceptance criteria

openQuestions.question: What exact AI confidence threshold requires manual review?
Who is the backup approver for screening/scheduling escalation?
What retention/deletion policy applies to CVs, transcripts, and test submissions?
What exact Drive folder, ownership, webhook renewal, and naming convention should be used for MVP?
What is the final combined pass/fail policy across screening, interview, and test?
What is the Calendar reschedule/cancel policy after event creation?
Which specific recruitment publishing channels are included in the Phase 2 prototype connector set?
Which export file formats are required for generated recruitment content beyond TXT/DOCX?
What mock design asset sizes/templates are required for banners, posters, and social assets?
What level of CV evidence detail is required: extracted text only, evidence spans, or reasoning trace?
